Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Katy, Texas, and began a left turn when Driver 2 struck
the side of the vehicle. Both drivers stated that the collision occurred as described, and independent witnesses at the
scene gave consistent accounts that matched Driver 1's version of events. Photographs taken at the scene show
damage to the driver's side that lines up with the direction and force of the impact, and no prior damage to the vehicle
was reported or observed. The Passenger was present in the vehicle at the time of impact, which was confirmed by
the responding officers and by the witnesses. Driver 1 reported a knee injury, and the nature of that injury is
consistent with the type and force of the collision. Driver 1 is litsed as a named driver on the insurance policy covering
the vehicle. Officers noted no citations at the scene and recorded the locations of both vehicles as they came to rest.
